answer: Ephemeral Challenge Lattice. Each identity must solve a fresh, randomly generated constraint-satisfaction problem whose solution space narrows with every wrong submission, so no answer can be copied or replayed. Solutions are only accepted once the network reaches a quorum summit on that round's unique instance. An attacker cloning identities hits a ledge: each clone needs its own solver run, and the compute plus latency cost scales linearly per identity with no reuse across rounds. A rotating beacon broadcasts the new instance seed, invalidating all prior work.
